svg.title: The model's Kenyon cell input was a third stronger than flies'; at the measured size the cells answer less and MBON11 gets a third of flies' charge
svg.text: The Kenyon cells' input was a third stronger than flies'
One projection neuron spike gave a Kenyon cell 1.90 mV: the calibration aimed at 1.4 mV after the synapse's resting depression, but these synapses don't depress.
At the measured size the cells answer at the low end of flies' density, 4-methylcyclohexanol reaches a seventh as many cells as 3-octanol, and MBON11 gets under a third of flies' charge.
One spike's EPSP in a Kenyon cell (mV)
